title: Economic Development: Main Exam, 22 August 2019
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE (COMPULSORY) AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS.

parts.text: Industrialization is the way to go if developing nations are to change their status. Discuss some of the importance of industries in development.
Briefly explain the following classifications of an industry.
State four emerging trends in economic development.
Discuss the role of co-operatives in development.
Explain some of the reasons that a country may introduce tariffs in international trade.
What are some of the characteristics of an underdeveloped country?
Discuss the weaknesses of the Malthusian theory of economic development.
Briefly explain the Millennium Development Goals.
Highlight some of the policies that can be implemented to reduce levels of unemployment in developing countries.
Explain the role of government intervention in the market system.
Discuss the functions of microfinance organizations in economic development.
i) What is globalization? ii) How has globalization helped developing nations to develop economically?
Discuss the Big Push Theory of economic growth, clearly showing the types of indivisibilities.
